topic.title: Fire Safety / Approved Document B / Regulation 38
topic.source_contract: building use, compartmentation, means of escape, fire service access, active systems, external walls, structural fire resistance, Regulation 38 information, commissioning and operational maintenance evidence

scope_guards: Following an Approved Document is not treated as automatic compliance in every design.
A fire strategy is not treated as installed fire precautions.
A product classification is not treated as correct installation.
A planning fire statement is not treated as building regulations approval.
A commissioning plan is not treated as completed testing.
A Regulation 38 handover list is not treated as delivered information.
A completion certificate is not treated as ongoing maintenance compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact design, approval, installation, commissioning, handover and maintenance evidence.
